buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 4. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 5. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained

mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 6. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 7. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 25% of total value. 8. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 9. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name CENTRAL COALFIELDS LIMITED Account No. 10106155123 IFSC Code SBIN0010400 Bank Name STATE BANK OF INDIA Branch address STATE BANK OF INDIA, CCL CAMPUS BRANCH, RANCHI . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Clause 10 is applicable for submission of EMD and Security Deposit only. The bidder may please note that EMD is to be submitted in the form of BG only. However bidders can also submit EMD with payment online through RTGS/internet banking as mentioned at clause 10. The e-PBG mentioned in the Bid Document is Security Deposit Bank Guarantee. In addition to this, the successful bidder shall submit a PBG amounting to 10% of entire contract value

(including CAMC charges). The PBG(s) shall remain valid up to three months beyond the ex piry of entire contractual period including CAMC period (also mentioned under Section-II of ATC attached under Clause 11 of bid document). Bidder as well as OEM for tendered items i.e Bowser Automation and Fuel Level Monitoring System are required to submit the following certificate - MII certificate (Annexure-II under S ection-II of ATC attached under Clause 11 of bid document), Banning/Non-Banning Certifica te (Annexure-VI under Section-II of ATC attached under Clause 11 of bid document) and Cer tificate for Land Border Sharing (Annexure-III under Section-II of ATC attached under Clause 11 of bid document) Bidders are requested to refer Scope of Work for delivery details of the items. Note for the bidders- The Supplier shall complete the supply and delivery of all materials covered under the Contract at Central Stores, Barkakana, Ramgarh, within 90 (ninety) days from the date of Award of Contract (AOC). Upon receipt of the materials at Central Stores, the materials shall be taken over and delivered to the resp ective end-user locations by CCL through its concerned Depot Officers. In the event the supplier fails to complete the supply of the materials at Central Store s within the stipulated period of 90 (ninety) days from the date of AOC, Liquidated D amages (LD) for delay in supply shall be levied for the period of delay beyond the sai d 90-day period, in accordance with the applicable LD provisions of the Contract/PO. .
